result.summary: The main issue is the broken rendering of imagery within the UI, specifically the food icons/thumbnails, which are displayed as abstract, cartoonish placeholders instead of actual restaurant food photos, indicating a potential image loading or data retrieval failure.

issues.description: Image placeholders/thumbnails for restaurants like Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccolo, Tokumaru Ramen Bar, and the pizza item appear as cartoon/graphic illustrations rather than actual food photography.
issues.suggestion: Check the API response and image cache logic to ensure high-quality food images are fetched and rendered correctly instead of falling back to default placeholders.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is partially cropped/cut off at the bottom of the screen, which limits user visibility of the offer.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding of the ScrollView or container to ensure the last list item is fully visible and not obstructed by the navigation bar.
